meta.title: LightLearnTech | Education. Technology. Opportunity.
meta.description: LightLearnTech expands access to quality education and technology for underserved children and young people in Nigeria, including children in IDP camps, with a special focus on girls in technology.

hero.heading: Education. Technology. Opportunity.
hero.text: LightLearnTech works to expand access to quality education and technology for underserved children and young people. We strengthen foundational learning and develop pathways into digital literacy, programming, STEM, robotics and emerging technologies, equipping young people with the knowledge and skills to pursue future opportunities.

challenge.heading: Displacement makes learning gaps harder to close
paragraphs: Nigeria's education crisis is particularly severe for children affected by displacement.
For displaced children, limited access to quality teaching and learning resources makes gaps in foundational learning even harder to close.

pathway.heading: From strong foundations to advanced technology

featuredProject.text: Our first field engagement, at an IDP camp in Benue State, highlighted significant gaps in foundational learning and limited teaching resources.

cta.heading: A child's circumstances should not define their potential.
